entries.hook: US Sen. Hagerty: the government holds ~200,000 BTC from seizures with no plans to sell (X News, Oct 28-29)
entries.suggested_post:
The US government: 200,000 BTC, no plans to sell.

Me: sold a slice to split a dinner bill.

The government has better diamond hands than you. Let that sink in.
entries.suggested_alt:
Uncle Sam is HODLing harder than half of crypto Twitter.

What's the dumbest thing you ever sold sats for?
entries.cta: Repost it for the friend who sold for a pizza. Follow for more HODL therapy.
entries.why_shareable: Buff vs. Cheems is instantly readable; 'dumbest thing you sold sats for' invites confession replies
entries.image_alt: Buff Doge: Uncle Sam: 200,000 BTC, no plans to sell. Cheems: Me: sold 0.01 BTC to split a dinner bill

entries.suggested_post:
Me, with a perfectly good cold wallet, looking at a coin with a dog on it.

We've all been this guy. How much did it cost you?
entries.suggested_alt:
My cold wallet: loyal, secure, 21 million cap.

Me: "but this one has a cartoon mascot."
entries.cta: Bookmark this for the next time a shiny ticker winks at you.
entries.why_shareable: Most famous format on the internet; 'how much did it cost you?' drives replies from anyone who chased an altcoin
entries.image_alt: Distracted boyfriend: Me looking at new coin with a dog logo while my Bitcoin cold wallet watches

entries.hook: Glassnode: Bitcoin 1-month realized volatility ~25%, matching mid-2023 lows, after the Fed held rates (X News, Oct 29)
entries.suggested_post:
Bought Bitcoin for the adrenaline.

Volatility just hit 2023 lows.

I've been sold the most boring roller coaster on Earth. Anyone else checking if the chart is frozen?
entries.suggested_alt:
They said Bitcoin was too volatile.

Now it moves less than my landlord's rent.
entries.cta: Save this for when it gets wild again. It will.
entries.why_shareable: Gru format everyone knows; 'is the chart frozen?' is relatable this week but news-dependent
entries.image_alt: Gru's plan: Buy Bitcoin for the thrill, strap in for wild swings, volatility at 2023 lows, volatility at 2023 lows

entries.format: Bernie: I Am Once Again Asking
entries.suggested_post:
Every week someone asks if they can just make more Bitcoin.

No. 21 million. That's the whole point.

What's the wildest question you've had to answer about it?
entries.suggested_alt:
21 million.

Not 22. Not "a few extra for emergencies." That's what the dollar is for.
entries.cta: Save this for the next 'just print more' conversation.
entries.why_shareable: Known format + core 21M fact newcomers learn; good for quote-posts, less universal punch
entries.image_alt: Bernie I am once again asking: Me to every can't-they-just-make-more guy: accept there will only ever be 21 million

entries.suggested_post:
Halloween tip: never think about what your candy cost in Bitcoin.

The scariest thing at my door was the opportunity cost.
entries.suggested_alt:
Trick-or-treaters: cute.

Realizing that candy cost 0.5 BTC in 2013 money: horror movie.
entries.cta: Repost this to haunt someone who spent sats in 2013.
entries.why_shareable: Seasonal and relatable 'spent BTC early' regret; strong this week, dates after Oct 31
entries.image_alt: Panik Kalm Panik: Trick-or-treaters at the door / I have candy / I bought it with Bitcoin in 2013

visual_suggestion.description: Doorbell rings, kids in costumes; calm hand gives candy; zoom on a receipt reading 'paid in BTC, 2013'; screen flashes lime 'PANIK'. 6-8 s.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.suggested_post:
I explained Bitcoin to my dad for three hours.

He asked where I keep the coin.

What's the best question you've gotten from family?
entries.suggested_alt:
Three hours on decentralization, scarcity and self-custody.

Dad: "So can you show me the coin?"
entries.cta: Save this for Thanksgiving. You'll need it.
entries.why_shareable: Orange-pilling family is universal; question invites people to share their own stories
entries.image_alt: Navy card: I explained Bitcoin to my dad for three hours. He asked where I keep the coin.

entries.suggested_post:
Long-term holder. Ten-year horizon.

Checked the price before brushing my teeth.

How many times today? Be honest.
entries.suggested_alt: My investment horizon is a decade. My attention span is 90 seconds.
entries.cta: Bookmark it and look at this instead of the chart next time.
entries.why_shareable: Every holder obsessively checks the price; honest-count question pulls replies
entries.image_alt: Two buttons meme: Check the price / Check the price again; a long-term holder at 9:01 AM sweating

entries.suggested_post:
The four stages of trading enlightenment.

Which stage are you at? Wrong answers will be screenshotted.
entries.suggested_alt:
Bought the top. Sold the bottom. Bought back higher.

At dinner I call it "a long-term strategy."
entries.cta: Repost if you've done all four in one week.
entries.why_shareable: Format everyone knows; 'which stage are you?' invites replies and quote-posts
entries.image_alt: Expanding brain: buying the top, selling the bottom, buying back higher, calling it a long-term strategy at dinner

visual_suggestion.description: Four quick beats, one per stage: a white Bitcoin icon glows brighter each beat while text appears (buy top, sell bottom, buy back higher, 'long-term strategy'); final beat a lime brain explodes into confetti. 6-8 s, loopable.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.hook: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in ~$286M net over Oct 26-27, led by BlackRock's IBIT (X News, Oct 28)
entries.suggested_post:
Bitcoin ETFs bought $286 million in two days.

Wall Street finally learned my strategy: buy while everyone at dinner says it's dead.

Who at your table is still saying it?
entries.suggested_alt:
Spot ETFs: $286M of inflows in two days.

Suits buying the dip. Me buying the dip. Only one of us gets a bonus for it.
entries.cta: Repost it for the friend who's been buying while the group chat laughed.
entries.why_shareable: Relatable 'buy while they mock you' feeling, but needs the ETF news to land
entries.image_alt: Navy card: Bitcoin ETFs just bought $286M in two days. Wall Street finally learned to buy while dinner says it's dead.

entries.hook: A well-known investor called Bitcoin a 'dead network' this week (X News, Oct 28); Halloween week
entries.suggested_post:
Bitcoin got declared dead again this week.

Just in time for Halloween. It's the only thing that rises from the grave on schedule.
entries.suggested_alt:
Another Bitcoin obituary dropped.

At this point it's not dying, it's a recurring role.

How many funerals have you attended?
entries.cta: Save this for the next obituary. Follow if you've been to more than three.
entries.why_shareable: Classic 'Bitcoin is dead' running gag + Halloween timing; holders love it, newcomers may not
entries.image_alt: Always has been astronauts: Wait, Bitcoin is dead again? Always has been.

entries.suggested_post:
Self-custody means nobody can touch my seed phrase.

It's on a sticky note. On the router.

Where's yours? Wrong answers only.
entries.suggested_alt:
Not your keys, not your coins.

My keys, also not my coins. I laminated the Wi-Fi password.
entries.image_alt: Navy card: Self-custody: nobody can touch my seed phrase. It's on a sticky note. On the router.
entries.why_shareable: Relatable self-custody fear any holder or newcomer gets; tag-a-friend angle
entries.cta: Save this as your reminder to move that sticky note.

entries.format: This Is Fine (dog in burning room)
entries.suggested_post: Leverage is great. You get to experience a whole bear market in four minutes.
entries.suggested_alt:
50x long. Room's on fire. Coffee's still warm. We're fine.

What's the most leverage you've ever regretted?
entries.image_alt: This is fine dog: Me, 4 minutes into my 50x long
entries.why_shareable: Format everyone knows; universal leverage pain, invites "been there" replies
entries.cta: If this was you, a repost helps the next guy step away from the 50x button.

visual_suggestion.description: This Is Fine-style scene (original cartoon dog, not the copyrighted art): calm dog at a desk sipping coffee as a phone shows a lime '50x LONG' position; the room slowly fills with flames as a red candle drops; dog says 'this is fine'. Caption on top: 'Me, 4 minutes into my 50x long'. 6-8 s, loopable.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.hook: Fed FOMC rate decision is today, Oct 28
entries.suggested_post:
Fed day.

I will not be reading the statement. I will be watching a 1-minute candle have a nervous breakdown.

Statement readers or candle watchers?
entries.suggested_alt: FOMC day: 400 words from the Fed, 4,000 candles from me.
entries.image_alt: Drake meme: rejects reading the Fed's rate decision, approves watching the 1-minute Bitcoin chart have a panic attack about it
entries.why_shareable: Format everyone knows; tied to today's Fed decision so it dates fast
entries.cta: Bookmark it for the next Fed day. There's always a next Fed day.

entries.hook: Halloween week; spooky-season formats trending (TikTok trend reports, Oct 2026)
entries.suggested_post:
Halloween costume this year: guy who was promised a post-halving bull run.

No makeup needed. Just waited.
entries.suggested_alt: Still waiting on the halving pump. At this point I'm not HODLing, I'm decomposing.
entries.image_alt: Waiting skeleton on a bench: Me waiting for the bull run I was promised last halving
entries.why_shareable: Known format plus Halloween week; halving-wait pain is relatable but seasonal
entries.cta: Save this for next Halloween. You'll probably still be waiting.

visual_suggestion.description: Time-lapse of a skeleton on a park bench holding a phone with a Bitcoin chart: seasons cycle behind it (leaves fall, snow, spring) while text 'waiting for the post-halving bull run' stays on top; ends on a lime 'still HODLing' tag. 6-10 s.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.hook: Google Trends: 'bitcoin' search interest at a five-year low (X News, Oct 27)
entries.suggested_post:
Google searches for Bitcoin just hit a five-year low.

So it's not just my family.

Who in your house stopped asking?
entries.suggested_alt:
Bitcoin search interest is at a five-year low.

Finally, the whole internet reacts to Bitcoin the way my group chat does.
entries.image_alt: Navy card: Bitcoin Google searches just hit a five-year low. So it's not just my family.
entries.why_shareable: Needs the news hook (search interest low) to land; dates fast
entries.cta: Repost it for everyone who's been orange-pilling an empty room. Follow for the next one.
